question: Show violation counts by type for the last 6 months.
text: Over the past 6 months, the most common violation types reported were PEST_EVIDENCE (375 reports), WATER_DAMAGE_MOLD (323), and DAMAGED_SURFACES (311). Less frequent violations included NO_HEAT (59 reports) and BLOCKED_EGRESS (64). The data shows that pest evidence and water damage/mold issues are the most prevalent concerns in recent reports.
sql:
SELECT reports.violation_type, COUNT(*) AS violation_count
FROM fixit.gold.reports
WHERE reports.reported_at >= date_add(MONTH, -6, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND reports.violation_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY reports.violation_type
ORDER BY violation_count DESC
